_about: Per challenge or duel: [title, rule, note]. An empty note means none. Keys follow challenges/README.md and challenges/duels.md.
c002: Bite into a lemon wedge and keep a straight face for 10 seconds. One grimace and you've lost.
c003: Try these four: roll your tongue, raise one eyebrow, wiggle your ears and touch your nose with your tongue. How many of the four can you do?
c004: Copy these five emojis using only your face, two seconds each: 😱 🤨 😴 🤢 😍
c007: Do something completely ordinary, like combing your hair or pouring a glass, in extreme slow motion for 20 seconds, face included.
c008: Someone says a sentence without sound. You guess what they said.
c010: Film something backwards, like taking your coat off, and play it in reverse so it looks almost normal. The more real it looks, the better.
c014: Make sock puppets and tell a story with them.
c016: Film your pet, stuffed animal or houseplant and voice 20 seconds of what's going on in its head.
c018: Give live sports commentary while someone does something everyday.
c027: Take a photo of an object that seems to have a face.
c028: Take a photo where you hold the moon between two fingers.
c029: Photograph something at home so close up that nobody can tell what it is, and let viewers guess.
c033: Use at least 30 photos to make a stop-motion clip in which things on your table come to life by themselves.
c039: Act out a movie. Viewers guess which movie it is.
c046: Send your ugliest selfie to someone you know.
c049: Wear an outfit that belongs to someone else.
c050: Impersonate three people you know, like how they laugh or talk, and let them guess who's who.
c051: Wave at a stranger and see if they wave back.
c062: Send someone a message to thank them. One tap shares it on WhatsApp.
c063: Send a message to someone you haven't talked to in a long time. One tap shares it on WhatsApp.
c064: Secretly do a chore someone else at home usually does, and film their reaction when they find out.
c077: Hang a spoon from the tip of your nose. How many seconds does it stay there?
c080: Flip a plastic bottle with a little water in it so it lands upright. How many in a row can you land?
c094: For 30 seconds, copy everything the person facing you does, like a mirror, while they keep making it harder.
c099: Do a dance with your friends.
c101: Take the funniest selfie you can.
c102: Do an impression of a famous person.
c103: Share a photo of yourself as a kid.
c104: Take a selfie with the biggest double chin you can make.
c105: Take a selfie from below, straight up your nostrils.
c106: Press your face flat against a window and have someone take a photo from the other side.
c107: Stick a piece of tape over your nose and cheeks and take a selfie.
c108: Draw a mustache on your finger and hold it under your nose.
c109: Spray whipped cream on your chin like a beard and take a selfie.
c110: Take a selfie with your family where everyone pulls a silly face.
c111: Show your most embarrassing photo from the past.
c112: Recreate a baby photo of yourself as exactly as you can.
c113: Take the funniest photo of your pet.
c114: Photograph your pet in its weirdest sleeping position.
c115: Take a selfie together with your pet.
c116: Film your pet when you come home.
c117: Show the trick your pet can do.
c118: Give your pet a new toy and film what it does.
c119: Hide and give a friend or housemate a fright. Not when they're on the stairs.
c120: Secretly take something from a friend without them noticing, then give it back.
c121: Draw a fake tattoo and make someone believe it's real.
c122: Answer everything someone says with "why?" and film it.
c123: When you eat out, tell the restaurant it's someone's birthday when it isn't.
c124: Set a photo of a cracked screen as the wallpaper on the phone of someone at home.
c125: Secretly stick a funny note on a friend's back. How long do they walk around with it?
c126: Stick a note under someone's computer mouse so it stops working.
c127: Put a photo of yourself in a picture frame at home and wait until someone notices.
c128: For one minute, repeat everything your brother, sister or friend says.
c129: Lip-sync part of a well-known song without sound. Viewers guess which song it is.
c130: With your eyes closed, taste what someone gives you and guess what it is.
Say first if you're allergic to anything.
c131: Stick a note with a famous name on your forehead and ask questions to guess who you are.
c132: Draw something in 10 seconds. Viewers guess what it is.
c133: Let a friend do your make-up.
c134: Keep a sip of water in your mouth while someone tells jokes. Spit it out and you're out.
c135: Read a sentence aloud with your tongue sticking out.
c137: Make a face out of the food on your plate.
c138: Let someone do your hair in the craziest style.
c139: Share a photo of your favorite food.
c140: Share a photo of your morning drink.
c141: Share a photo of something you don't like to eat.
c142: Take a photo of cheap but tasty food.
c143: Take your most beautiful nature photo.
c144: Take the best photo of the rain.
c145: Take the most beautiful photo of the clouds.
c146: Take a photo of something funny you see on the street.
c148: Take a photo of your favorite candy.
c149: Take a photo of your parents' ugliest clothes.
c152: Wear two different shoes or socks.
c153: Toss a piece of candy up and catch it in your mouth.
c154: Throw a ball of paper into the bin from across the room.
c156: Teach your dad, mom, grandpa or grandma a slang word.
c157: Buy someone a little gift, just because.
c158: Send your parents a message with only emojis.
c159: Make breakfast in bed for someone at home.
c160: Bring treats for everyone at work or school.
c162: Treat your friends to a round of drinks.
c164: Have a pillow fight with your brother, sister or friend.
c165: Do a dance together with your dad or mom.
d001: Look someone straight in the eyes for 30 seconds without laughing. Whoever laughs loses.
d002: Stay serious for 30 seconds without laughing.
d003: Give someone a really angry look without laughing.
d004: Give someone a really sad look without laughing.
d005: You both get the same emoji and copy it.
d006: Show your craziest dance move in 10 seconds.
d007: Act out an animal without sound. Whoever is clearest wins.
d008: Play air guitar like a rock star. Whoever plays best wins.
d009: Whoever goes first sings part of a song. The other sings it back.
d010: Draw rock, paper or scissors and show it. Whoever wins, wins the duel.
d011: For one minute you may only say "yes" or "no" while someone asks you questions.
d012: Whoever goes first holds a pen between their teeth and says an easy word. The other guesses the word.
d013: Whoever goes first films a small part of the room they're in. The other guesses which room it is.
d014: Let out your craziest laugh. The craziest laugh wins.
d015: Say "I'm hungry" in your silliest voice.
d016: Tell your funniest joke. The funniest one wins.
d017: You're late. Come up with the craziest excuse.
d018: Beatbox for 10 seconds. Whoever beatboxes best wins.
